For accurate preview of batches with duplicate users, call this      function separately for each unique user.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.graceWindow: Seconds the previous signer's in-flight vouchers stay        claimable after rotation (0 = old vouchers die immediately)

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

assayVerifierPaidOf(address).notice: Cumulative amount the verifier has claimed as its own cut from this         provider's pool, across signer rotations (what the cut cap is checked against).

claim(address,address,uint256,uint64,byt.notice: Redeem a cumulative PayoutVoucher signed by the provider's assay signer.         Anyone may submit; funds always go to the voucher's node address.         Replays are inert: cumulative must strictly exceed what the node has         already withdrawn, and only the delta is paid. The voucher binds the         provider, so two providers sharing one signer cannot pay each other's         vouchers out of their own pool.

clearAssaySigner(uint256).notice: Leave assay mode: settlements go back to the provider wallet from         the next round. The current signer's in-flight vouchers stay         claimable for graceWindow; after that the pool can be withdrawn.

setAssayNode(address,bool).notice: Allow or revoke a payee address for the calling provider's pool.         claim() pays only listed nodes (the signer's own cut is governed         by the cap instead), so a signer cannot route the pool to an         address the provider never approved.

setAssaySigner(address,uint256).notice: Register or rotate the assay voucher signer for the calling provider.         A non-zero signer switches the provider's settlements into assay-pool         mode: settled funds accumulate in the pool and GPUs withdraw them via         claim() with an EIP-712 PayoutVoucher signed by this signer.

setAssayVerifierCutCap(uint256).notice: Cap (in basis points of the provider's cumulative pool deposits) on the         cumulative amount the assay signer may claim for itself as its cut.
